comment: All gameplay constants. Restart the server after you edit this file. In "level", set the level 1 value and the level 15 value. Every level in between is a straight line between those two numbers. Whole numbers are rounded to the nearest integer. Add "round": "none" on a stat to keep decimals. "fixed" values do not change with level.

minSpeedKmh.comment: Slowest airspeed, in km/h. This is both the HUD number and the speed used to move the plane.

maxSpeedKmh.comment: Fastest airspeed at full throttle, in km/h. This is both the HUD number and the speed used to move the plane.

speedAccelerationKmhPerSec.comment: How fast the HUD airspeed climbs or falls while you hold speed up or speed down, in km/h per second.

turnRateDegPerSec.comment: How fast the plane turns, in degrees per second.

cameraScale.comment: How far the view zooms out. 1 is the closest view at level 1. Smaller numbers show more of the map. Level 15 is 0.5, which shows twice the width and height.

treatmentPerSecond.comment: Health restored every second while alive.

levelUpHeal.comment: Health restored once, at the moment you gain a level.

outOfMapHpFractionPerSecond.comment: Fraction of max health lost every second while flying outside the map. 0.2 means 20% of max health per second.

xpToNextLevel.comment: Experience required to reach the next level. 100 at level 1 and 1500 at level 15 keeps the old curve, where the cost is level times 100.

rocketCapacity.comment: How many rockets you can hold.

rocketDamage.comment: Damage of a direct rocket hit before blast falloff. Bots multiply this by botDamageMultiplier.

rocketRange.comment: How far a rocket flies before it disappears, in world pixels.

rocketPrepareMs.comment: Wait after a launch before the next rocket can fire. This blocks the button even when ammo remains. It is separate from rocketChargeMs, which only refills ammo.

rocketChargeMs.comment: Milliseconds to reload one rocket after you spend ammo.

rocketTrackingConeDeg.comment: Half-angle of the forward view, in degrees. Straight ahead is 0. The rocket only considers planes between -this and +this.

rocketTrackingRange.comment: How far a rocket can see a target to home in, in world pixels.

rocketTurnRateDegPerSec.comment: How fast a homing rocket can turn, in degrees per second.

mineCapacity.comment: How many mines you can hold.

mineDamage.comment: Damage of a mine hit before blast falloff. Bots multiply this by botDamageMultiplier.

mineSlowMs.comment: How long a mine slows a hit plane. Airspeed eases down to half of minimum speed, and turn rate eases down to half of the level's original turn rate. Both stay there, then ease back. Fast during the slow flies at minimum speed, because half of minimum times the 2x boost is minimum speed. After the slow ends, that boost can still be at 2x top speed. Level 1 is 2 seconds. Level 15 is 4 seconds. Rockets do not slow planes.

minePrepareMs.comment: Wait after a drop before the next mine can drop. This blocks the button even when ammo remains. It is separate from mineChargeMs, which only refills ammo.

mineChargeMs.comment: Milliseconds to reload one mine after you spend ammo.

fastDurationMs.comment: How long the speed boost lasts, in milliseconds.

fastCooldownMs.comment: How long you wait before the speed boost can be used again, in milliseconds. The wait starts when the boost starts.

worldSpeedScale.comment: Turns real km/h into map pixels. World speed is km/h times this number, divided by kmhToMetersPerSecond. Raise it to cross the map faster without changing the HUD speed.

kmhToMetersPerSecond.comment: Unit conversion from km/h to meters per second. Leave at 3.6 unless you want to rescale every speed at once.

botSpeedMultiplier.comment: Bots move and launch weapons at this fraction of a human plane's speed.

botDamageMultiplier.comment: Bots deal this fraction of rocket and mine damage.

fastTopSpeedMultiplier.comment: During a boost, top speed is maxSpeedKmh times this number.

fastBoostKmhPerSec.comment: How fast the boost adds km/h while it is active.

fastRecoveryKmhPerSec.comment: How fast km/h falls back to normal after a boost ends.

overspeedBrakeMultiplier.comment: If a level-up leaves you above your new top speed, you slow down this many times faster than normal acceleration.

rocketLaunchSpeedMultiplier.comment: A rocket starts at the plane's current world speed times this number, then speeds up to rocketMaxSpeed.

rocketMaxSpeed.comment: Top rocket speed in world pixels per second. Bots use this times botSpeedMultiplier.

rocketRampMs.comment: Milliseconds for a rocket to go from its launch speed to rocketMaxSpeed.

rocketLifetimeMs.comment: A rocket disappears after this many milliseconds even if it has range left.

rocketMuzzleOffset.comment: How far in front of the plane a rocket appears when it becomes active, in world pixels.

rocketBlastRadius.comment: Rocket explosion radius in world pixels. Damage falls off toward the edge.

rocketBlastScale.comment: Visual size of a rocket explosion.

hitRadiusPadding.comment: Extra pixels added around a rocket when it checks for a hit. 0 makes the rocket a point.

playerHitRadius.comment: Human plane body radius for rocket hits, in world pixels. Two thirds of the previous 42.

botHitRadius.comment: Bot plane body radius for rocket hits, in world pixels. Two thirds of the previous 34.

rocketClashDistance.comment: Two enemy rockets destroy each other when their paths come this close, in world pixels. 0 means they meet only as points.

rocketClashBlastScale.comment: Visual size when two rockets destroy each other.

mineLifetimeMs.comment: A mine explodes on its own after this many milliseconds.

mineTriggerScale.comment: A mine launches when a plane comes within its trigger radius times this number.

playerMineTriggerRadius.comment: Base trigger radius around a human plane, in world pixels.

botMineTriggerRadius.comment: Base trigger radius around a bot plane, in world pixels.

mineExpireRadius.comment: Explosion radius when a mine times out, in world pixels.

mineExpireDamageRatio.comment: Timeout explosion damage is mine damage times this number.

mineExpireBlastScale.comment: Visual size of a mine timeout explosion.

mineMissileMaxSpeed.comment: Top speed of the missile a mine fires, in world pixels per second. Bots use this times botSpeedMultiplier.

mineMissileConeDeg.comment: Homing cone of a mine missile, in degrees.

mineMissileTrackingRange.comment: How far a mine missile can chase, in world pixels.

mineMissileTurnRate.comment: How fast a mine missile turns, in degrees per second.

mineMissileRange.comment: How far a mine missile flies, in world pixels.

mineMissileLifetimeMs.comment: A mine missile disappears after this many milliseconds.

mineMissileBlastRadius.comment: Mine missile explosion radius, in world pixels.

mineMissileBlastScale.comment: Visual size of a mine missile explosion.

teamBlastDamageMultiplier.comment: Teammates take this fraction of blast damage when team damage is on.

blastFalloffMin.comment: Splash damage at the edge of a blast is at least this fraction of the direct hit. 0.12 means 12%.

hitHealRatio.comment: The shooter heals this fraction of the damage their blast actually dealt.

killHealMaxHpRatio.comment: Extra heal on a killing blast, as a fraction of the victim's max health.

minKillScore.comment: Lowest score granted for a kill.

killScoreBase.comment: Score for killing a plane of your own level, before the level-gap bonus.

killScorePerLevelGap.comment: Extra score per level the victim is above you. Negative when the victim is lower level. The total still cannot go below minKillScore.

minKillXp.comment: Lowest experience granted for a kill.

killXpBase.comment: Experience for killing a plane of your own level, before the level-gap bonus.

killXpPerLevelGap.comment: Extra experience per level the victim is above you. The total still cannot go below minKillXp.

minHitXp.comment: Lowest experience granted for a hit that does not kill.

hitXpDamageRatio.comment: Experience for a non-killing hit is damage times this number.

respawnXpKeepRatio.comment: Fraction of your total experience kept when you respawn. 0.1 means you keep 10%.

respawnDelayMs.comment: Milliseconds before a destroyed plane respawns.

spawnInvulnerableMs.comment: Milliseconds after spawn when you cannot fire, drop mines, or take damage.

levelsPerPlaneTier.comment: Plane, rocket, and mine artwork steps up every this many levels. 3 means levels 1-3 use tier 1, 4-6 use tier 2, up to tier 5.

nameMaxLength.comment: Maximum characters in a pilot name or team code.

botCount.comment: How many bots the server keeps in the world.

botSpawnWeights.comment: Chance weight for a new bot's level. The first number is level 1. Current weights are 40, 30, 20, 10 for levels 1 through 4.

botReactionMs.comment: Delay before a bot acts on a new decision, in milliseconds.

botSightRange.comment: How far a bot looks for a target, in world pixels.

botPreferHumanChance.comment: When both humans and bots are in sight, chance the bot picks a human.

botLockMs.comment: How long a bot keeps the same target, in milliseconds.

botRetargetMs.comment: How long a bot waits after losing a target before it searches again, in milliseconds.

botRocketCooldownMs.comment: Minimum wait between bot rocket shots, in milliseconds.

botRocketCooldownRandomMs.comment: Extra random wait added to the bot rocket cooldown, in milliseconds.

botAimToleranceDeg.comment: A bot fires only when its nose is within this many degrees of the aim point.

botRocketRangeFraction.comment: A bot fires only inside this fraction of its rocket range.

botSpeedUpDistance.comment: A bot accelerates when the target is farther than this, in world pixels.

botSpeedDownDistance.comment: A bot slows down when the target is closer than this, in world pixels.

botMineDistance.comment: A bot drops a mine only when the target is behind it and closer than this, in world pixels.

botMineBehindFraction.comment: How far behind the bot's nose the target must be before a mine drop. 0.25 means a quarter of the distance behind the nose.

botMineCooldownMs.comment: Minimum wait between bot mine drops, in milliseconds.

botMineCooldownRandomMs.comment: Extra random wait added to the bot mine cooldown, in milliseconds.

botWanderLeftChance.comment: Chance a wandering bot turns left on its next decision.

botWanderRightChance.comment: Chance a wandering bot turns right. It goes straight when the roll is above left plus right.

botWanderSpeedDownChance.comment: Chance a wandering bot slows down.

botWanderMinMs.comment: Shortest time a bot keeps a wander decision, in milliseconds.

botWanderRandomMs.comment: Extra random time added to a wander decision, in milliseconds.

worldWidth.comment: Map width in world pixels. Applied when the server starts.

worldHeight.comment: Map height in world pixels. Applied when the server starts.

worldSeed.comment: Random seed for trees, rocks, lakes, flowers, and clouds. The same seed always builds the same map.

spawnEdgeMargin.comment: Planes spawn at least this far from the map edge, in world pixels.

spawnClearance.comment: Planes try not to spawn closer than this to each other, in world pixels.

spawnAttempts.comment: How many times the server tries to find a clear spawn point before it places the plane anyway.

cloudCount.comment: How many clouds are placed on the map.

cloudMarginX.comment: Clouds stay at least this far from the left and right edges.

cloudMarginY.comment: Clouds stay at least this far from the top and bottom edges.

cloudSizeMin.comment: Smallest cloud size, in world pixels.

cloudSizeMax.comment: Largest cloud size, in world pixels.

variantCount.comment: How many artwork variants exist for each map object, numbered from 1.

featureMargin.comment: Trees, rocks, lakes, and flowers stay at least this far from the map edge.

featurePlaceAttempts.comment: Tries per object to find a spot that does not overlap another object.

treeSizeMin.comment: Smallest tree size, in world pixels.

treeSizeMax.comment: Largest tree size, in world pixels.

treeClearance.comment: Minimum distance from a tree to any other object, in world pixels.

flowerSizeMin.comment: Smallest flower size, in world pixels.

flowerSizeMax.comment: Largest flower size, in world pixels.

flowerClearance.comment: Minimum distance from a flower to any other object, in world pixels.

rockSizeMin.comment: Smallest rock size, in world pixels.

rockSizeMax.comment: Largest rock size, in world pixels.

rockClearance.comment: Minimum distance from a rock to any other object, in world pixels.

lakeSizeMin.comment: Smallest lake size, in world pixels.

lakeSizeMax.comment: Largest lake size, in world pixels.

lakeClearance.comment: Minimum distance from a lake to any other object, in world pixels.

blastFrameMs.comment: Milliseconds each explosion animation frame is shown.

blastFrameCount.comment: Number of frames in the blast1.png explosion sheet. Five columns and three rows, read left to right, top to bottom. The last frame index is this number minus 1.

blastDurationMs.comment: An explosion is removed after this many milliseconds. 15 frames at 55 milliseconds each.

maxDeltaSeconds.comment: Longest simulation step, in seconds. Stops a stall from moving planes too far in one tick.

tickMs.comment: How often the server simulates the world, in milliseconds.

broadcastMs.comment: How often the server sends the world to clients, in milliseconds.
